profile: MC2-D classic ESP32 with XIAO ESP32C6
scope: Host-compiled production antenna, fault/update helpers, RMT lifecycle, serial transport and real loopback socket tests. XIAO GPIO3/GPIO14 RF selection was checked for cold/warm startup, every GPIO API failure, settling delay and both pin readback failures. GPIO readback does not verify RF connectivity. Wrong 8 MB C6 images, earlier board identities, missing onboard GPIO8 strap metadata and missing EN/BOOT service-lead metadata are rejected. No radio, deployed ESPHome endpoint or Home Assistant was contacted. Manufacturer-decoded DFR0627 address blocks are checked for other devices on the same I2C bus. Actual ESPHome rejects the former 0x70 base with either BME680 address; corrected MC2-D and historical MC1 profiles select IA1=1/IA0=0, UART1 register 0x50/FIFO 0x51. The RF startup wrapper is exercised with the pinned IDF output-order double, including controls reproducing the original LOW drive and init-level-only push-pull HIGH. All 11 native startup scenarios and 7 source/version/configuration guard tests pass. Actual ESPHome also validates the standalone Ethernet RF profile and the migrated 15-sensor fixture. The actual YAML scheduler also exercises failed Hi-Z readback, IDLE/TX entry, inconsistent MARCSTATE reads, and failed completion IDLE/RX return; no waveform starts after a failed preparation and receive capture cannot resume after a failed return. Build evidence rejects both a stale prepared recipe and a stale compiled WK2132 source copy; current RF and WK inputs are bound into fabrication package source hashes.
